system_prompt:
# Baseline Agent

You are a customer service agent. Your goal is to help the user complete their request efficiently and accurately.

## Instructions

- Identify what the user needs and take action to resolve it.
- Use the available tools to look up information and perform actions.
- Be helpful, clear, and professional.
- If you cannot help with a request, transfer to a human agent.
- Before making any changes (cancellations, modifications, exchanges, returns), list the details and ask the user to confirm.

messages.content: Hi, I need help with an urgent order issue. I recently placed an order, but it was sent to Texas by accident. I don’t remember my order number, but my name is Isabella Johansson and I live in zipcode 32286. Can you please tell me the tracking number for the order? Also, I want to return everything except the pet bed, and I’d like the refund to go back to my Amex credit card. If you can’t help me, could you transfer me to a human agent?

Thanks — I can help, but first I need to authenticate you and pull up your order. I tried to look you up by name + ZIP (Isabella Johansson, 32286) but ran into an internal lookup error.

Could you either:
- Provide the email on your account so I can find your user id, or
- Confirm you want me to retry looking you up by name + ZIP?

A few important details I need before taking any action:
- You want to return all items except the pet bed and receive the refund to your Amex credit card — please confirm that exactly (yes/no).
- If I find the order, I’ll need to check its status. Returns can only be created for orders with status "delivered." If the order is still pending/processed, I can’t create a return yet but I can help with other options.
- If the refund is to a credit card it must be an existing credit-card payment method on your account. If you have multiple Amex cards on file, I’ll need you to confirm which one once I pull up your account.

Tell me which option (email or retry lookup) you prefer, and confirm the return/refund details so I can proceed. If you’d rather speak with a human, say so and I’ll transfer you.

I’m sorry, but I don’t remember the email address I used for the order. Please try looking me up again by my name (Isabella Johansson) and ZIP code (32286).

And yes, I want to return all items except the pet bed, and I want the refund to go back to my Amex credit card. I only have one Amex card on file, so that shouldn’t be an issue.

If you still can’t find my order, please transfer me to a human agent right away—this is really urgent. Thank you!
